title: A part sale deposit syncs to QuickBooks like a work order's
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner/Admin user (that role holds every permission, including BOTH Part sales - Create & Edit AND Invoicing & payments - Create & Edit).
  • A customer to sell to exists.
  • A part sale in Estimate, Approved or Complete status, for the customer, with a part (for example "Brake Pads"; Quantity 1; Sell Price for example $290.91).
  • QuickBooks connected with the one-time bookkeeping consent given.
custom_steps:
1. Record a deposit and let it sync to QuickBooks; confirm it appears as an unapplied payment behind the same one-time consent.
  2. Create Invoice on the sale and confirm the deposit is applied when the invoice is created.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The deposit syncs to QuickBooks as an unapplied payment, behind the same one-time consent, and is applied when the invoice is created - the same terms as a deposit on a work order.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10269 (Take a deposit on a part sale); Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 8; design canvas boards S8_*; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R12: “A deposit on a part sale syncs to QuickBooks on the same terms as a deposit on a work order: as an unapplied payment, behind the same one-time consent, applied when the invoice is created”
